description: Create all 12 public-facing pages: index.php, about.php, services.php, plans.php, trainers.php, classes.php, gallery.php, blog.php, post.php, contact.php, thank-you.php, and sitemap.php/robots.php. Each page includes header.php and footer.php, loads SEO dynamically, and displays content from the database.
steps: Create index.php (Home) with all sections: hero section with dynamic heading/subheading/buttons, trust badges, about preview, services grid, membership plans cards, trainers showcase, classes schedule, gallery preview, transformation section, testimonials carousel/grid, free trial CTA, FAQ accordion, and final CTA section.
Create about.php with dynamic about content from admin, gym story section, mission/vision, and why choose us section.
Create services.php listing all services from database in card grid format with icons/descriptions.
Create plans.php showing all active membership plans with pricing cards (monthly/quarterly/yearly), features list, highlight for featured plan, and enquiry CTA buttons.
Create trainers.php showing trainer profile cards with photo, name, specialty, experience, bio, and Instagram link.
Create classes.php showing class schedule in a clean layout with class name, trainer, time, days, duration, and description.
Create gallery.php with filterable image grid (by category) and lightbox functionality for viewing full-size images.
Create blog.php with blog listing showing title, featured image, excerpt, author, date, and category. Include pagination if needed.
Create post.php for single blog posts with full content, author info, date, breadcrumbs, related posts section, and SEO meta from blog_posts table.
Create contact.php with contact information (address, phone, WhatsApp, email, business hours), Google Map embed, and contact form (name, phone, email, message) that saves to enquiries table.
Create thank-you.php with success message after form submission, links back to homepage and other pages.
Create sitemap.php that generates dynamic XML sitemap with all pages and blog posts. Create robots.php that outputs robots.txt content dynamically.
acceptance_criteria: All 12+ public page files exist and pass php -l syntax check
index.php contains all specified home page sections (hero, trust badges, about, services, plans, trainers, classes, gallery, transformations, testimonials, free trial CTA, FAQ, final CTA)
Contact form processes submissions and saves to enquiries table
Free trial form (on index.php or modal) saves to enquiries table with enquiry_type='free_trial'
Blog listing and single post pages load dynamic content
All pages include proper SEO meta tags loaded from database
Gallery page has category filtering and lightbox
verification: Run php -l on all public PHP files to verify no syntax errors
Verify each file includes header.php and footer.php
Verify contact.php has form processing logic with PDO prepared statements
Verify index.php contains all required sections
findings: All 13 public-facing PHP files created and pass php -l syntax check. Pages: index.php (full home with hero, trust badges, about, services, plans, trainers, classes, gallery, transformations, testimonials, free trial form, FAQ accordion, final CTA), about.php, services.php, plans.php, trainers.php, classes.php, gallery.php (with category filter and lightbox), blog.php, post.php (with related posts and blog SEO meta override), contact.php (with contact form saving to enquiries), thank-you.php, sitemap.php (XML sitemap), robots.php (dynamic robots.txt). Free trial form on index.php saves to enquiries with type free_trial. Contact form saves with type contact. Both redirect to thank-you.php on success.
